description_en: Configures operation log delivery for specified products and writes the logs to a Simple Log Service (SLS) project and Logstore of the current account
description_zh: 为指定产品配置操作日志投递，将日志写入当前账号的 SLS Project 和 Logstore
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center deliver-to-user-sls --sls-region-id cn-hangzhou --delivery-scopes ProductType=CloudBrowser --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeliverToUserSls

parameters.help_en:
The name of the SLS project to be created or reused. The name must start with `elastic-desktop-`.

Specify either this parameter or `ExistedProjectName`. If the project does not exist, it is created. If the project already exists, it is reused
parameters.help_zh:
待创建或复用的 SLS Project 名称，必须以 `elastic-desktop-` 开头。

与 `ExistedProjectName` 选择一个填写。Project 不存在时创建，已存在时复用
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en:
The name of the destination Logstore. The name must start with `elastic_desktop_`. If the Logstore does not exist, it is created. If the Logstore already exists, it is reused.

If this parameter is not specified, the part after `elastic-desktop-` in the selected project name is used as a suffix to generate a name that starts with `elastic_desktop_`. For example, if the project name is `elastic-desktop-audit`, the default Logstore name is `elastic_desktop_audit`
parameters.help_zh:
投递目标 Logstore 名称，必须以 `elastic_desktop_` 开头。不存在时创建，已存在时复用。

省略时，使用所选 Project 名称中 `elastic-desktop-` 后的部分作为后缀，生成 `elastic_desktop_` 开头的名称。例如 Project 为 `elastic-desktop-audit` 时，默认为 `elastic_desktop_audit`
parameters.name: log_store_name

parameters.help_en:
The data retention period of the new Logstore. Unit: days.

Valid values: 1 to 3650.

Default value: 30.

If an existing Logstore is reused, this operation does not update its data retention period
parameters.help_zh:
新建 Logstore 的数据保留时长，单位为天。

取值范围： 1～3650。

默认值： 30。

复用已有 Logstore 时，本接口不更新其数据保留时长
parameters.name: ttl

parameters.help_en:
The name of an existing SLS project. The name must start with `elastic-desktop-` and the project must already exist in the specified SLS region of the current account.

Specify either this parameter or `ProjectName`
parameters.help_zh:
已有的 SLS Project 名称，必须以 `elastic-desktop-` 开头，且在当前账号指定的 SLS 地域中已存在。

与 `ProjectName` 选择一个填写
parameters.name: existed_project_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the destination SLS project is located. This parameter is required
parameters.help_zh: 投递目标 SLS Project 所在的地域标识，必填
parameters.name: sls_region_id

fields.help_en: The product type to which the logs belong. Specify the product type for which you want to enable log delivery. For example, `CloudBrowser` indicates Cloud Browser
fields.help_zh: 日志所属的产品类型。应填写需要启用日志投递的产品类型，例如 `CloudBrowser` 表示云浏览器
fields.name: product_type

parameters.help_en: The list of product scopes for which delivery needs to be configured. Specify at least one item. You cannot create duplicate enabled delivery configurations for the same account and product type
parameters.help_zh: 需要配置投递的产品范围列表，至少填写一项。同一账号、同一产品类型不能重复创建已启用的投递配置
parameters.name: delivery_scopes

schema.description_en: The processing result of the delivery configuration

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. It is used to troubleshoot call issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的标识，用于定位调用问题
